announcements.headline: Result of 2026 Annual General Meeting
announcements.insight: This announcement provides the outcome of the annual general meeting, which is a routine governance event for shareholders. It typically confirms the results of shareholder votes on standard matters such as director reappointments or auditor appointments.

announcements.headline: Conclusion of CMA Investigation
announcements.insight: The conclusion of a Competition and Markets Authority investigation signifies the end of regulatory uncertainty regarding potential competition concerns. This closure allows the company to proceed with its business operations without the immediate threat of imposed remedies or restrictions.
